notablePrerequisites: You control lands that can produce at least {7}.
description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque's last ability by tapping it, making Palinchron an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, making a token copy of Palinchron and giving it haste.
The Palinchron token enters the battlefield, untapping seven lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding {7}.
Repeat from step 2.
